↳ Posted by Jeffery on August 14th, 2007.

I used to play in a band called ‘Reed Riot’ with David Lim, and another well-known piper Becky Taylor (early nineties) ‘Bunnie’s Hat’ had just been written at that time (originally called ‘Mending the Bunnies Hat’ - forgive me, Dave…) with another tune of David’s which was just as good - and in the unusual key of F sharp minor. I can’t remember the name of it, but next time I see him, I’ll remind him about it and post it up. David was (and probably still is) a great tune writer and ace piper - as well as a really nice bloke
